name: dedge-deepseek-harness-vscode
description: Self-contained DeepSeek Harness coding agent for VS Code with a Windows-safe runtime and isolated Codex/Claude handoffs.

virtualWorkspaces.description: DeepSeek Harness requires a local or remote filesystem-backed workspace.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The workbench and diagnostics remain available, but the Harness runtime cannot start until the workspace is trusted.

commands.title: DeepSeek Harness: Configure Vision API Key
DeepSeek Harness: Clear Vision API Key

enumDescriptions: Use the platform runtime shipped in the VSIX.
Use an explicitly configured executable. No automatic downloads.
dedgeDeepSeekHarness.runtime.mode.description: Runtime source. Bundled mode is the supported end-user path.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.runtime.command.description: Absolute path to a dsh executable or dsh JavaScript entry file when runtime.mode is external.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.runtime.nodePath.description: Required absolute Node executable when runtime.command points to a .js, .mjs, or .cjs entry file.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.runtime.startTimeou.description: Maximum time allowed for the local Harness host to become ready.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.model.description: Default model for newly created sessions.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.provider.description: Harness provider route. deepseek-official uses the native DeepSeek adapter; other routes use the bundled multi-provider pi-ai adapter.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.reasoningEffort.description: Default reasoning effort for new sessions. Available values are provided by the selected model adapter.

enumDescriptions: Allow workspace and temporary-directory mutations; ask before wider access.
Allow unrestricted mutations without approval prompts.
Show an approval request for actions outside the workspace policy.
Keep workspace-write sandboxing and automatically allow each pending approval once.
dedgeDeepSeekHarness.approvalPolicy.description: Approval behavior used with workspace-write permissions. Approve for me never enables unrestricted filesystem access.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.baseUrl.description: DeepSeek, Anthropic-compatible, or OpenAI-compatible API base URL. The official DeepSeek endpoint is used by default; self-hosted and sub2 endpoints may be configured here.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.autoStart.description: Keep one shared bundled runtime available after VS Code finishes starting, even when the workbench is closed.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.schedule.enabled.description: Mount the official DeepSeek Harness dsh-schedule plugin. It adds session-local scheduled follow-ups and requires a Harness restart when changed.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.context.maxBytes.description: Maximum bytes of editor context attached to a prompt.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.context.pasteFileTh.description: Pasted text larger than this many bytes is stored as a file in the extension storage; the prompt only receives the file path so the model can read it selectively.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.context.windowToken.description: DeepSeek context-window capacity in tokens. Defaults to the official adapter maximum (1M); the compaction-enabled official presets start automatic compaction at 80% to preserve response headroom, while manual compaction may run earlier when idle. Minimal has no compaction; custom presets define their own policy. Applies after a runtime restart.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.handoff.codexHome.description: Read-only Codex home used by the official app-server session list and the filtered JSONL fallback. ${userHome} and ~ are expanded by the extension.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.handoff.claudeHome.description: Read-only Claude Code home used to discover local sessions. ${userHome} and ~ are expanded by the extension.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.handoff.codexComman.description: Optional absolute path to a native Codex executable. Leave empty to discover the official CLI or VS Code extension binary without invoking a shell.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.handoff.claudeComma.description: Optional absolute path to a native Claude Code executable. Leave empty to discover the official VS Code extension binary or PATH executable without invoking a shell.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.handoff.maxBytes.description: Maximum UTF-8 transcript bytes included in an isolated cross-platform handoff package.

enumDescriptions: Copy a ready-to-paste take-over prompt to the clipboard; start a new session in your Codex or Claude Code extension and paste it. Never spawns terminals.
Launch the native CLI/extension executable directly with the handoff prompt.
dedgeDeepSeekHarness.handoff.launchMode.description: How a hand-off to Codex or Claude Code is delivered. Clipboard mode keeps VS Code extensions (Codex, Claude Code) able to take over the task in their own session.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.skills.directories.description: Directories scanned for SKILL.md documents. Type @ in the composer to reference a skill; the referenced SKILL.md body is attached to the prompt when sending. ${userHome} and ~ are expanded by the extension.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.vision.baseUrl.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible auxiliary vision endpoint. When enabled from the composer, it describes images in an extra request before Harness receives the prompt.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.vision.model.description: Auxiliary vision model name. This model is called only when the composer auxiliary-vision toggle is enabled.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.vision.modelOverrid.description: Per-main-model auxiliary vision toggle values managed by the composer. False sends images directly when the main model supports them.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.compaction.provider.description: Optional provider used for compaction summaries. Empty inherits the conversation route.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.compaction.model.description: Optional model used for compaction summaries. Empty inherits the conversation route.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.vision.reasoningEff.description: Optional reasoning_effort sent to the Vision endpoint. Leave empty for providers that do not support this parameter.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.vision.maxBytes.description: Maximum encoded image bytes sent to the vision endpoint per attached image.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build && pnpm run prepare:runtime
